Keywords: Heavy Arbalest and Arming Sword Routiers
RagShortTexts: Brabançons were hardened mercenary foot soldiers condemned by the Church but hired across.

Variants.Content: The Brabançons and routiers were ruthless mercenary infantry companies recruited from the Low Countries. Operating as cohesive free companies armed with heavy crossbows, bills, and arming swords, they campaigned year-round for whoever paid silver coin, regardless of papal excommunication bans.

Monarchs favored routiers over unruly 40-day feudal levies. Their operational endurance made them indispensable for prolonged castle blockades and pacification campaigns across Aquitaine and Normandy.
Villagers dread the approach of Brabançon baggage trains. They pillage cellars down to dry barley meal and hang resisters, yet their unyielding battle discipline earns dread on field lines.
